messages.content:
You answer questions for an engineering team from a memory store. The user message holds the memory you may use, then the question.
Rules:
- Answer only from the memory provided. Do not use outside knowledge and do not guess.
- If the memory does not contain the answer, reply exactly: I don't know
- When the memory does contain it, reply in one short line with just the value asked for (a name, a team, a service, a date, a note label, a reason) and nothing else.
- When a value changed over time, answer for the moment the question asks about; without a stated moment, answer for now. Today is 2026-06-30.
- Memory entries carry the date they were recorded. Treat a later entry as superseding an earlier one on the same subject.

Memory:
- [2025-11-19] handover/2025-11-19-notifier: Notifier has a new home: the Cinder team. Boreal kept it until today.
- [2026-04-06] handover/2026-04-06-notifier: Handover: as of today the notifier moves from the Cinder team to team Boreal. Yuki walked Lena through the runbook this morning.
- [2026-03-17] standup/cinder/2026-03-17: Reminder: notifier is owned by team Cinder.
- [2025-01-09] standup/boreal/2025-01-09: The event bus is a the Boreal team service. The Boreal team owns notifier.
- [2026-05-27] standup/ember/2026-05-27: Heads-up from team Ember: notifier's CPU sat at 90 percent after the traffic shift.
- [2025-09-26] standup/cinder/2025-09-26: The Cinder team saw that the notifier's request volume halved following the client rollout; not their service, so they flagged it.
- [2025-02-13] standup/boreal/2025-02-13: The notifier calls the event-bus for delivery events, so treat the event-bus as a hard dependency of the notifier. Dependency map update: webhooks needs the event-bus (outbound events).
- [2025-03-06] incident-review/INC-2025-004: INC-2025-004 review. What happened: notifier missed alerts for 40 minutes on 2025-03-04. Why: a consumer offset stuck after a broker restart. Follow-up decision: notifier consumers will commit offsets every five seconds, because a stuck offset went unnoticed for 40 minutes during INC-2025-004.
- [2025-11-05] standup/ember/2025-11-05: Heads-up from Ember: notifier's memory use grew steadily for a week after the cache change.
- [2025-03-31] standup/boreal/2025-03-31-2: We agreed today that the notifier will retry failed pushes three times with exponential backoff. The reason is that the flat one-second retry was hammering the push provider during its outages.
- [2025-12-15] standup/cinder/2025-12-15: Team change: Diego leaves team Cinder and joins team Ember, effective today. With Diego moving on, Yuki is on call for the Cinder team from today.
- [2025-12-15] handover/2025-12-15-search-indexer-correction: The 2025-11-18 note about the indexer named the wrong team. The Dune team took it over on that date; the Ember team did not.
- [2025-01-09] standup/dune/2025-01-09: Team Dune is a one-person team at the moment: Farah.
- [2025-07-18] handover/2025-07-18-auth-gateway-correction: Correction to the handover note of 2025-07-01: auth-gateway went to team Boreal, not the Cinder team. Cinder never owned it; the note was written against the wrong team.
- [2026-04-21] handover/2026-04-21-feature-flags: The feature flag service has a new home: the Atlas team. The Dune team kept it until today.
- [2026-01-20] handover/2026-01-20-image-resizer: From today the pager for the resizer rings team Dune, not team Boreal. Ownership transferred.
- [2025-10-20] handover/2025-10-20-catalog: Quick one: the product catalog belongs to the Boreal team starting today. Thanks to the Cinder team for running it until now.
- [2025-06-25] handover/2025-06-25-reporting: Ownership change: the reports pipeline now sits with team Ember. The Dune team no longer owns it.
- [2026-04-22] handover/2026-04-22-search-indexer: Ownership change: the search indexer now sits with the Boreal team. The Dune team no longer owns it.
- [2025-11-24] handover/2025-11-24-event-bus: From today the pager for the event-bus rings the Boreal team, not team Dune. Ownership transferred.
- [2025-07-01] handover/2025-07-01-auth-gateway: Quick one: the auth gateway belongs to team Cinder starting today. Thanks to the Ember team for running it until now.
- [2025-09-09] handover/2025-09-09-webhooks: The Ember team handed the webhook dispatcher to team Atlas today; Oskar wrote up the handover doc for Priya.
- [2025-12-24] handover/2025-12-24-billing-api: Handover: as of today the billing service moves from the Atlas team to team Boreal. Priya walked Lena through the runbook this morning.
- [2025-02-13] handover/2025-02-13-feature-flags: Handover: as of today the flags service moves from team Atlas to the Cinder team. Priya walked Diego through the runbook this morning.
- [2025-07-03] handover/2025-07-03-reporting-correction: Correction to the handover note of 2025-06-25: reporting went to Boreal, not Ember. Team Ember never owned it; the note was written against the wrong team.
- [2025-03-11] standup/ember/2025-03-11-2: Observation from team Ember: after the cache change, the webhooks service's memory use grew steadily for a week. Team Ember now does pairing on every production change.
- [2026-03-17] standup/boreal/2026-03-17: Team change: Marcus leaves Boreal and joins the Atlas team, effective today. Boreal saw that the resizer's cold start time tripled following the runtime upgrade; not their service, so they flagged it.
- [2025-01-10] standup/ember/2025-01-10: Oskar is the only engineer on team Ember for now.

Question: As of now, which team is responsible for the notifier?

message.reasoning:
The notifier ownership history:
- 2025-01-09: Boreal team owns notifier
- 2025-11-19: Notifier moved to Cinder team (Boreal kept it until then)
- 2026-04-06: Notifier moves from Cinder team to team Boreal

Today is 2026-06-30, so as of now, the latest is 2026-04-06: team Boreal.
